_comment: Configuration for the unsupervised anomaly model tuning sweep. The model is NEVER trained on weak labels; SOVON mortality context is used only as a model-SELECTION criterion. See src/avian_biosurveillance/modeling/tuning.py for the methodology.
_mode_comment: axis = one-factor-at-a-time around the live config baseline (cheap, interpretable). product = full Cartesian grid (expensive). Both are capped by max_configs.
_objective_comment: Weighted sum of above-random ranking skill against weak labels minus a specificity guardrail penalty. AUROC contributions are mapped via max(0, auroc-0.5)*2 so 0.5 (random) scores 0. Missing metrics contribute 0.
_penalty_comment: Subtracts penalty * mean(|non_target_species_AUROC - 0.5| * 2). High alignment on non-target species suggests confounding rather than species-specific signal.
